scenes.text: This tutorial covers Distributed Jobs. Submit and monitor spaCR work on SSH workstations, Slurm clusters, or cloud and HPC commands.
Open Distributed Jobs from the Data and batch runs section. Configure a remote profile, connection method, working directory, environment, and data paths.
In the main configuration area, define scheduler resources, command templates, file synchronization, credentials, and status polling.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. submit a small validation job before scaling to expensive analyses.
When the workflow finishes, local records track remote job identifiers, logs, state, transferred artifacts, and failures.
